responsibility: Declares the Rust backend helpers responsible for compiling inline assembly HIR nodes into GCC tree asm expressions. It defines the two focused lowering classes—one for Rust InlineAsm and one for LLVM-style inline asm—and their helper interfaces for constructing the asm template, operand lists, clobbers, labels, and final ASM_EXPR tree, separating this specialized asm-lowering API from the general expression compiler.
same_name_distinction: Declares the CompileAsm and CompileLlvmAsm interfaces and helper methods for inline-assembly lowering, while the same-named .cc file provides the actual ASM_EXPR-building logic and operand/clobber construction.
